title: Checking apartment documents in Dushanbe before buying
excerpt: What to compare in seller documents, property records and the agreement before paying. Confirm the required documents and their validity with the notary and registration authority for the transaction.
contentHtml:
Substantively updated on 15 October 2026.

Separate three questions: who is entitled to sell, exactly which property is being sold and what the agreement will require. A prepared question list helps identify inconsistencies but does not guarantee the absence of every legal risk.

The seller and the basis of title

Compare the seller’s identity with the documents supporting their rights to the particular apartment. Ask how it was acquired: purchase, inheritance, gift or another basis. Where a representative acts, clarify the scope and validity of their authority. A document copy alone does not prove that a right is valid or invalid; documents and records need checking through the applicable procedure.

The property and registered records

Compare the address, area, designated use and identifying details. Ask the notary and registration authority which current records of encumbrances, restrictions and right holders are needed. Do not rely on a universal promise that a certificate is valid for two days: verify the document type, timing and procedure for your transaction. Record who will obtain the documents and when they will be checked.

Layout and condition

Compare the actual layout with technical documents. Resolve discrepancies and documents covering alterations before buying. It cannot be assumed that every violation automatically becomes entirely the buyer’s responsibility or that an apartment will qualify for a mortgage. Discuss particular consequences with the relevant professional and collateral requirements with the lender.

Deposits and preliminary terms

Before transferring money, establish how the payment is documented, the parties’ obligations and refund conditions. A payment label in a message does not replace contract terms. Agree on the form of a preliminary agreement, any required certification and a suitable payment process with a notary for the particular situation. Do not use a universal template without checking the property and parties.

Handover and payment

Check that the final agreement matches the verified records. Clarify registration, payment, keys, vacant possession and included furnishings. Put important seller promises in writing. Keep the agreement, payment evidence and agreed handover record.

faq.q: Does one certificate guarantee clear title?
faq.a: We do not claim such a guarantee. Seller, title, property, restriction and agreement information must be considered together for the particular transaction.

faq.q: How many days before the transaction should documents be obtained?
faq.a: There is no single timing stated here for every document. Confirm validity and the obtaining procedure with the notary and issuing authority.
